sloka: धनुषा ज्या गुणवता सप्त बाणान् मुमोच ह ।रुक्म पुंखान् महावेगान् सुपर्ण अनिल तुल्य गान् ॥३-३-११॥
transliteration: dhanuṣā jyā guṇavatā sapta bāṇān mumoca ha ।rukma puṁkhān mahāvegān suparṇa anila tulya gān ॥3-3-11॥

translations.english: Then Rama strung his bow immediately, shot the sharp arrows at Viradha and hit him verily.
